about: INDIRECT (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 18; ADR-0124's notes of 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-12): A1-style text naming a cell or a range of the same Sheet, with or without its own qualifier, read as it stands after the recalculation (volatile). Its text is not rewritten by an insertion or a deletion. The forms the seventeenth Windows run and the two area passes of 2026-10-12 observed are read as Excel reads them, and so are those that follow from them by the rule they settle. R1C1 text (a1 FALSE, 0, a blank or left empty): R and C each with a number counted from 1, leading 0s and all (R3C2, R03C2), an offset in brackets from the Formula's own cell, 0 and a + included (R[1]C[-1], R[0], R[-0], R[+1]), or no number, the Formula's own row or column (RC[-1], R[2]C); a row part alone a whole row (R3, R[1]), a column part alone a whole column (C2, C[-1]); two parts of the same kind joined by ':' the rectangle they span (R2:R3, RC[-1]:R[1]C[-1]); parts of two kinds joined name no place, #REF! (R2C2:R3, R3:C2); and a cell followed by # its Spill Range, as A1# is (R1C1#). A structured reference's text is read as the typed Table[Column] is, whatever a1 says, and A1# as the typed A1# is. INDIRECT-067 to INDIRECT-081 ask the forms that follow from the observed ones. #VALUE! until a run observes them: in R1C1 style, a row or column number 0 (INDIRECT-073) and an offset past the Sheet's edge, which Excel reads as a place (INDIRECT-052 is 0, a blank cell) though no run has told whether it wraps round to the far side or stops at the edge (INDIRECT-082 to INDIRECT-084 ask it). #VALUE! by decision (ADR-0049's rule 2, a Linked Table is read by key, never by position; decided with the user 2026-10-12): a declared Linked Table's bare name, in either style, which Excel reads as the table's data (INDIRECT-043 and INDIRECT-053 to INDIRECT-057 record Excel's answers). Text that names no place is #REF!: a number past the Sheet's edge, as XFE1 is (INDIRECT-017; INDIRECT-074 asks it in R1C1 style), another Sheet's name, and a table or column that does not exist.
